title: VTB's Earnings Are Falling Faster Each Quarter
subtitle: First-half profit fell by a fifth, but the second quarter alone was down by a third, and the bank is now planning to cut a tenth of its staff.

source.name: VTB first-half 2026 results reported by Kommersant

data.label: Net profit, first half
data.annotation: 225.2 billion rubles, down almost a fifth year over year.

data.label: Net profit, second quarter
data.annotation: 92.6 billion rubles, a much steeper fall than the half-year figure implies.

data.label: Planned headcount
data.annotation: A tenth of staff is to go as costs rise sharply.

supportingFacts.label: The Gals Development sale that supports the result is being paid in instalments rather than up front.
The bank said it is unlikely to pay out half of its 2026 profit as previously indicated.

metadata.keyFinding: VTB second-quarter profit fell 33.6% and the bank plans to cut 10% of its staff.
